anatomy.flutter: Semantics(label, value) wraps SizedBox(height: Progress.height) -> Surface(spec: Shadows.inset, fill: theme.muted, border: theme.input, radius: pill) -> ClipRRect -> _AnimatedFractionalTranslation -> Surface(spec: tone.shadow, fill: tone.inkOf(theme)) as the indicator.
anatomy.web: ProgressPrimitive.Root (data-slot="progress", classes relative flex h-2.5 w-full items-center overflow-hidden rounded-pill border border-input bg-muted shadow-pressed) wraps ProgressPrimitive.Indicator (data-slot="progress-indicator", progressIndicatorVariants tone classes, translateX transform).

api.flutter: Progress(required double value, ProgressTone tone = normal, String? label) — value is non-nullable, so there is no way to construct an indeterminate instance; ProgressTone has 5 members (normal/value/success/warning/destructive) with label getter mapping normal -> 'default'.
api.web: Progress({ value, tone = "default", ...props }: ComponentProps<Root> & VariantProps<...>) — value is number | undefined; omitting it (or passing null) triggers `indeterminate` and applies `anim-progress-indeterminate w-1/3 flex-none transition-none` instead of the translateX transform; tone keys are the identical 5 strings.
api.note: Web adds an indeterminate mode (value omitted) that Progress in Flutter cannot express because value is a required non-nullable parameter; this is an addition on the web side, not a hole relative to Flutter, so it is recorded here rather than marked a gap against the web.

states.flutter: Only one state exists: determinate, driven by _AnimatedFractionalTranslation animating Offset(translation, 0) over MotionDurations.normal with MotionCurves.enter whenever `value` changes; there is no branch for an unknown/indeterminate reading.
states.web: components/docs/component-docs/progress/page.tsx's States section enumerates determinate, indeterminate, complete (value=100) and outside-safe-band (tone=destructive) as the real states, and marks hover/focus-visible/pressed/disabled as N/A because 'Progress is not a control'; indeterminate renders `anim-progress-indeterminate`, a travelling third-width sliver, and collapses to the channel start under reduced motion.
states.note: The indeterminate state is a web-only addition (see api dimension) enabled by Radix's own null-value convention; every other state (determinate + 5 tones) matches Flutter's single determinate path, and both sides correctly treat hover/focus/press/disabled as not applicable to a non-interactive readout.

disabled.flutter: Progress has no `enabled` parameter and StatelessWidget.build never branches on interactivity — there is nothing to disable because the widget is Semantics(value: ...) wrapping a static fill, not a control.
disabled.web: components/ui/progress.tsx defines no disabled styling and progress/page.tsx's StateGrid explicitly renders a 'disabled' cell with the literal text 'N/A', matching the 'Progress is not a control' framing used for hover/focus/pressed.
disabled.note: Both sides agree a read-only indicator has no disabled path; disabling the surrounding context (e.g. hiding the bar) is a call-site decision on both platforms, not something either Progress implementation models.

interaction.flutter: The widget tree has no GestureDetector, Focus, or FocusableActionDetector anywhere in build() — Progress cannot receive focus or pointer input at all.
interaction.web: ProgressPrimitive.Root/Indicator receive no tabIndex or key handling from Radix's Progress primitive, and progress/page.tsx's own comment states 'Progress is not a control — it has no tabIndex and no Radix-assigned keyboard behaviour, unlike the Slider it visually matches.'
interaction.note: Neither implementation is operable; both are a rendered reading, matching each other by both being genuinely non-interactive rather than one being interactive and undocumented.

semantics.flutter: Semantics(label: label, value: '${value.round()}%') attaches an accessible name (nullable — see the class doc's DRIFT 6 about the reference's first bar omitting it) and a value string to the platform accessibility node; no explicit progress role flag is set on the Semantics widget.
semantics.web: ProgressPrimitive.Root renders with Radix's implicit role="progressbar" and writes aria-valuenow from the now-correctly-forwarded `value` prop (the component's own comment records this was previously broken: value was destructured out and never passed back to the primitive, so aria-valuenow read null on a complete-looking bar); accessible name still requires the caller to pass aria-label/aria-labelledby, exactly like Flutter's optional `label`.
semantics.note: Both require the caller to supply the accessible name and both can render nameless (Flutter's own doc calls this out as DRIFT 6, reproduced from the reference); the mechanism differs — an explicit ARIA progressbar role plus aria-valuenow on web versus a platform Semantics value string on Flutter — but the announced information (name optional, numeric value always present when determinate) is equivalent.
